# Music credits

All tracks are released under **CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication)**. You may use, modify and sell them without attribution, but the credits are kept here out of courtesy.

Files were loudness-normalised (−20 LUFS), given a 1.5 s fade-in, and re-encoded to 96 kbps MP3 for the web. Tags were stripped.
